verdict.rationale: Browser-extension autofill of TOTP codes and passkeys is a fair question for an authenticator app like Authy, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only mobile, tablet, watch and desktop apps; the one mention of a Chrome extension calls it deprecated and describes using it to extract keys, not to autofill codes or passkeys during login. With no documented autofill capability, the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an everyday user, a browser extension autofills my TOTP codes and passkeys during login instead of making me retype them
